newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Sri Lanka Newspapers - April 25.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Sri Lankan press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Government decides to extend by one year term of office of police chief W.B. Rajaguru, despite calls from parliamentarians to let him retire.
Police shoot dead Tamil Tiger rebel who tried to kill officer in charge of Nelukulam police station in northcentral Vavuniya.
Police arrest five suspects in racket to supply forged visas to Tamil youth seeking to migrate to Australia.
Foreign Minister Lakshman Kadirgamar to hold talks with new Indian Prime Minister Inder Kumar Gujral in New Delhi.
Inter-monsoon thundershowers arrest fall in water levels in hydropower reservoirs.
